# LiveCaptionIt

> Free, in-browser live captions for any tab or your microphone. Whisper runs locally on your device (WebGPU/WASM); captions float in a Picture-in-Picture window over any app. No upload, no account.

## What it does
LiveCaptionIt captures audio from a browser tab (via the screen-share picker with "Share tab audio") or from your microphone, transcribes it with OpenAI Whisper running locally through transformers.js, and shows real-time captions in the page or in a floating Document Picture-in-Picture window. Transcripts can be exported (TXT/SRT/VTT) or shared via a self-contained URL.

## Privacy
Audio and transcripts are processed on your device. The speech model is downloaded once (~75 MB for the default model) and cached by the browser. Nothing is uploaded to a server. The marketing site uses GA4 page-view analytics only.

## Limits
- Works best in desktop Chrome, Edge or Brave (tab audio capture + Document PiP). Firefox/Safari support is partial.
- Can only caption audio the browser can hear: desktop apps (e.g. native Zoom/Teams) must be joined in the browser, or use microphone mode.
- Accuracy depends on audio quality, the chosen model and language; it is not a certified CART service.
- Supports 16 languages in the picker (incl. English, Hindi, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Chinese, Arabic) plus auto-detect.
